notes: Scheduled and manually dispatched strict runs use this Threadnote 4.1 beta public monorepo surrogate; ordinary pull requests do not materialize it.
The class mix and aggregate graph targets are retained shape evidence, not portable latency budgets or measured latency claims.
A checked performance artifact must come from a measured run; no synthetic latency baseline is accepted.
pnpm workspace exclusion models package-manager membership only; workspace exclusion never removes active source from graph eligibility.
The H1 target eligibility policy will exclude all SVG and low-signal JSON at or above 256 KiB before graph processing; recognized high-signal configs will have a separate 1 MiB hard cap.
Six linked-worktree churn scenarios are declared for retained evidence without synthesizing scenario latency measurements.
